newsitem.title: USA: Durakon sees contract improving results.
newsitem.headline: Durakon sees contract improving results.

text.p: Durakon Industries Inc, which reported a decline in first-quarter earnings, on Monday said a contract that went into effect in March should help improve its results in the coming quarters.
"After making very positive strides in profitability in 1996, we are disappointed by our first-quarter results," said David Wright, president and chief executive.

Durakon, which makes pickup truck bedliners, said its first-quarter performance was hampered by soft market conditions, competitive pressures and the costs of gearing up for a Ford bedliner contract, which started in March.
